items.name: bus
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one decorative website PNG icon, crisp and legible when rendered at 56–80 pixels.
Style: kawaii compact sticker silhouette, flat crisp editorial illustration, consistent thick dark ink outlines (#101a20), small square/pixel accents integrated into the object's details. Warm cream (#f4f6f2), soft lime (#d5ff58), tiny coral blush cheeks. Simple dot eyes and a small happy smile, subtle friendly charm. No gradients or shading.
Composition: exactly one single centered isolated object that generously fills a square image, minimal margin. Genuine transparent background with alpha, including any openings and all space surrounding the silhouette. Do not render a checkerboard, white rectangle, scene or background. No glow, cast shadow, drop shadow, external decorative sparks, extra characters, labels, watermarks or any text except specifically requested route badge. Must work on both dark ink and warm white page backgrounds. PNG, square.
Primary request: smiling San Francisco Muni-style modern city bus, compact front/three-quarter view. Recognizable bus shape, two simple wheels visible, broad windshield, cream body, lime lower panel and dark ink windows. Put small dot eyes, a simple happy curved smile and tiny coral cheeks on the front body panel. No destination words, numbers, route badge or branding.
